source.name: Meta's Apps
source.subtitle: Custom builds and forks by OMetaVR
source.description: IPAs I build myself, served straight from each project's GitHub releases.

apps.name: Distra
apps.subtitle: Discord with Vendetta, Bunny/Revenge and Enmity plugin support
apps.localizedDescription:
Discord mod for iOS: runs Vendetta, Bunny/Revenge, Enmity and Aliucord plugins, ships ~100 built-in plugins (all off by default), icon packs and app icons. Includes crash-loop protection with an automatic safe mode.

Unofficial modification, not affiliated with Discord. Client mods break Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk.

apps.name: uYouEnhanced
apps.subtitle: YouTube with uYou, PiP, dislikes and more
apps.localizedDescription:
uYouEnhanced, the continuation of uYouPlus: YouTube with uYou (background playback, downloads, no ads) plus a bundle of tweaks like YouPiP, Return YouTube Dislikes, DontEatMyContent, YouQuality and YTUHD options.

Built automatically from upstream releases by github.com/OMetaVR/uYouPlus.

apps.name: EeveeSpotify
apps.subtitle: Spotify with Premium features, lyrics and Liquid Glass UI
apps.localizedDescription:
EeveeSpotify (Reincarnated), the continuation of whoeevee's EeveeSpotify: unlocks Premium-only playback features in Spotify, adds custom lyrics providers, and an optional iOS 26 Liquid Glass interface.

This is the sideload build (with zxPluginsInject) for SideStore, AltStore and LiveContainer. A TrollStore build and jailbreak .debs are on each release at github.com/OMetaVR/EeveeSpotify.
